verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents real natural-language interaction. Users can chat in PR threads to ask follow-ups and challenge recommendations, teach review preferences through natural-language chat, prompt it to generate improvements, and investigate the codebase in natural language through the Slack agent. Much of the documented control surface is still structured @coderabbitai keyword commands, YAML configuration, and UI actions, so evidence that the product as a whole can be operated through natural language is incomplete. missing for 10: evidence that core operations (configuration, review control, triage actions) can be driven by free-form natural language rather than fixed commands or YAML, and independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: you can ask follow-up questions, request clarifications, challenge recommendations, or explore alternative approaches
Teach CodeRabbit your review preferences using natural-language chat.
Ask questions about your codebase, trace features, and cross-reference Sentry errors with merged PRs and Jira issues, all in natural language.
